Other areas on this side: the balance sheet, cash flow and the balance sheet, the quality of the business.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 18.6% lower than a year ago. Also against it: over the past year the share did 16.9 percentage points worse than the Nifty 50; growth scores only 27 of 100 against the comparison pool; and at a 12% discount rate the price implies 19.7% yearly earnings growth for 10 years, a demanding ask. Other areas on this side: growth, what the price implies.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 8 points in favour and 4 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 50 of 100. The side that carries most weight is growth.
